attempted_claim: Let M be a compact orientable 1-cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold admitting three distinct Dehn fillings M(alpha_1), M(alpha_2), M(alpha_3) each with finite nonabelian fundamental group. Is M homeomorphic to one of the SnapPy census manifolds m011, s757, v2702, v2797? Equivalently: prove that any such M admits at most three finite nonabelian fillings and that these four are the only manifolds attaining three.
decisive_failure: No certified global proof was possible: SnapPy hyperbolicity verification requires Sage (unavailable), Regina and Recognizer recognition are not installed, and low-index subgroup census cannot scale to large finite fillings such as order 2040. All computed evidence reproduces published census data rather than establishing the claimed uniqueness over all volumes.
